title: Chained Demon Awakening
description: A muscular purple demon with glowing blue energy erupting from its head and shoulders crouches in the center of a dark pit. It is surrounded by a chaotic tangle of broken metallic chains and shattered geometric fragments in shades of rust, silver, and grey.
